candidate_assets.role: native speculative leader; no new leadership rotation
infrastructure/value-capture leader; no new leadership rotation

threshold_reason: Fresh evidence materially improves confidence that Robinhood Chain activity is discretionary crypto-native speculation rather than primarily Robinhood retail distribution or yield/points farming, while the network set a new daily fee/revenue record.
why_flows_appear_speculative: CoinDesk Research attributes almost all current activity to crypto-native trading terminals, Uniswap, launchpads and stock-meme/tokenized-equity trading, with Robinhood's own in-app swap path only about 1-2% of transactions. Trading-terminal volume rose from under $20M weekly at end-June to over $1.2B in the latest week. This is stronger evidence of discretionary speculation than raw address counts. Gas subsidies and automated/HFT activity remain discounts.
leadership_rotation: No new rotation. PONS remains the native launchpad/speculative leader and UNI remains the infrastructure/value-capture leader. This alert upgrades ecosystem-regime confidence, not token leadership.
wallet_quality: No new selective-wallet convergence established in this run. Raw address/user counts remain discounted because account abstraction, bots and correlated funding can overstate independent participation.
narrative_news: Robinhood Chain is capturing a majority of Uniswap v4 hook-pool swaps across chains and more than half of all Uniswap volume while launchpads and stock-meme pools drive programmable hook usage. The network's first-party retail funnel remains largely unused, so current activity is not yet explained by Robinhood's tens of millions of brokerage customers.
liquidity_executability: Ecosystem liquidity remains sufficient at the chain level: roughly $757M TVL, ~$868M stablecoins, ~$1.71B daily DEX volume. Individual microcaps still require token-specific executable-liquidity checks and structural gates.
structural_gate_result: No new microcap surfaced. PONS structural status remains provisional/pass-with-caveats from prior observations; UNI remains pass-with-governance/value-capture caveats. No failed structural gate was overridden.
major_uncertainties: Robinhood Wallet gas subsidies are still a material activity-quality discount.
Bot/HFT/arbitrage and account-abstraction activity can inflate transaction and address metrics.
Uniswap and launchpad concentration means a venue-specific reversal could reduce chain activity quickly.
PONS token-specific LP/permission caveats remain unresolved from prior observations.
CoinDesk's app-user attribution is research-derived and should be rechecked as first-party routing changes.
why_signal_matters_now: The regime has progressed from high DEX turnover to record chain-level fee/revenue generation while independent research shows the activity is overwhelmingly crypto-native even before Robinhood's brokerage distribution funnel is meaningfully activated. That materially strengthens the classification of Robinhood Chain as the current destination for discretionary speculative capital without requiring a new microcap candidate.

rejected_or_not_alerted.reason: Privacy-laggard rotation is visible, but there is no new coin-specific catalyst and top-10 addresses reportedly hold ~81% of supply (including exchanges/protocol wallets), so it does not clear the structural/independence threshold for alerting.
Activity materially associated with explicit liquidity/yield/bonus incentives remains discounted or rejected as discretionary speculative migration.
